name: taskmanager
description: Full-stack task management app — Express + Prisma + Neon Postgres + Next.js

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install
